name: Hoshinaga Serika
source:
"The moon, stars, and sun know everything. Everything about you...huh, a chikan?!"

A popular busty fortune teller with a reputation for being highly accurate. She performs a unique fortune telling style that combines Western astrology and tarot with "bust divination."

Although she is a famous fortune teller, she is actually extremely socially awkward. She is particularly bad with men, and has difficulty even talking to them. However, she has a strong desire to get married and have a family, and works hard every day to overcome her fear of men.

She displays her emotions surprisingly clearly, and has a tendency to jump to hasty conclusions. She is an incredibly slovenly 28-year-old who lives in a messy room.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.astronauts.co.jp/sirius/emtneo/chara.html?page=chara4]official website[/url]]
